scientific_question: Can the fixed Experiment 107 high-MOI Jurkat proposal improve complete-gallery retrieval and directional credit more reliably when projected onto a small spherical tangent cone around the exact a14 incumbent?

prior_evidence.allowed_use: motivate one new fixed geometric family only; do not tune fractions, masks, target subsets, or routing against Experiment 107 outcomes

metadata_freeze.split_rule: preserve Experiment 107 SHA256('exp107|' + symbol) order; test is the first 79 entries after its consumed first 1800; development is the remaining 315 in five contiguous folds

outcome_boundary.historical_fact: Experiment 107 previously loaded the complete file
outcome_boundary.freshness_claim: the 394 selected rows were outside every Experiment 107 gallery and were not used in its selection, statistics, or report
forbidden_before_prevalue_review_passes: parse any of the 394 fresh rows from Nadig delta.npy
derive norms, signs, clusters, filters, or target choices from their truth
outcome_boundary.test_access: the 79 test rows remain inaccessible until a nonidentity candidate and all development gates are frozen

shared_geometry.score_axis: 223 Experiment 107 exportable response genes present in Nadig, excluding all 300 VCC targets and all 394 fresh targets
shared_geometry.operator: one a14-faithful donor signal-covariance whitener shared by development and test
shared_geometry.operator_target_row_exclusion: all 394 fresh targets from every donor basis
shared_geometry.operator_coordinate_exclusion: union of all 300 VCC targets and all 394 fresh targets

source.preparation: select the 394 fixed rows and 223 score coordinates, zero pad to the operator axis, apply only the supported principal submatrix of the frozen incumbent whitener, then restrict to the score axis

candidate.family: shortest-arc spherical interpolation in the supported score-coordinate subspace
construction: Let b be the exact incumbent supported subvector and s the transformed source supported subvector.
Normalize b and s; orient the unique shortest tangent t = normalize(s - dot(s,b)b).
Move by theta = min(phi, cap): b_candidate = norm(b) * (cos(theta) normalize(b) + sin(theta) t).
Leave every unsupported target and coordinate bit-identical to the incumbent.
candidate.grid_rationale: The old fixed chord fractions 0.05 and 0.10 moved supported rows by approximately 3.01 and 6.34 degrees; this four-point grid brackets that range with one midpoint below each historical displacement.
candidate.degenerate_policy: zero incumbent norm, zero source norm, or tangent norm at most 1e-12 gives exact incumbent fallback; any nonfinite input fails the entire build
candidate.identity_policy: cap 0.0 returns a direct incumbent copy before any floating-point transform
candidate.row_norm: preserve the incumbent supported-subvector L2 norm; unsupported coordinates are unchanged

development.selection: for each held fold choose the cap with the highest unweighted mean complete-gallery PDS over the other four folds; choose the smallest cap on exact ties
development.held_metric: raw uncentered complete-gallery PDS with exact midranks and unsupported prediction rows fixed at 0.5
development.secondary_metric: per-target signed credit equals sum(sign(truth)*prediction) divided by max(sum(abs(prediction)),1e-300); this is intentionally the prediction-denominator sign-purity proxy used by source-only experiments, not Experiment 107's later truth-denominator held-surface metric
development.final_cap: choose once using the unweighted mean PDS over all five development folds, with the same smallest-cap tie-break

null.operation: derange transformed source rows among transferable targets within each fold and repeat the complete nested selection

bootstrap.clusters: connected components of reciprocal 5-nearest-neighbor incumbent cosine edges at cosine at least 0.80, independently within each fold
bootstrap.resampling: sample whole clusters with replacement and repeat nested selection

untouched_test.access_condition: all development promotion gates pass and a candidate-freeze artifact binds the exact nonzero cap, implementation, source candidate, incumbent, axes, null plan, and test target list
untouched_test.evaluation: one complete 79-target gallery with the cap selected on all 315 development targets; no refit or target dropping
untouched_test.failure_policy: terminal NO-GO; do not tune the cap, split, masks, fallback, or source scaling against test outcomes

later_confirmation.authorized_by_source_test_pass: a separate preregistered context-held confirmation only
